name: session-tts
description: Read Claude Code-related audio cues locally with a different Japanese voice per session. The Stop hook injects a reminder asking Claude to summarize each turn in one short phrase via mid-turn say; permission prompts are narrated with the workspace name. Multiple hook reminders (TodoWrite/Monitor/Agent/UserPromptSubmit) nudge progress narration at milestones. ON by default; engine and models managed automatically. Apple Silicon only.
